_comment: Template of the child authority that helper/hash_child_recheck_correction.py expects.
This is a SYNTHETIC template. It does not point at the real media root and it is not
an authority for anything: the real hash child reports/v0-s3/preparation-03/independent-hash-child-01.json
is consumed and expired and is deliberately NOT reused or renewed by this work.
The production media root is hard disabled in the helper; a source root must sit inside an
explicit --allow-source-root entry and must carry the .lvw-synthetic-fixture-root marker file.
repo_root: <absolute path of the synthetic git repository>
inventory_receipt: <absolute path of the synthetic receipt file>
inventory_receipt_sha256: <64 hex sha256 of the receipt file bytes>
source_root: <absolute path of the synthetic fixture root>
